title: Argue with Me Tersely: Towards Sentence-Level Counter-Argument Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Using Chain-of-Thought (CoT) instructions to guide the language model to identify confirmation bias within original arguments and generate logical, multi-step counter-arguments.

Mitigating subjective human bias during dataset creation through annotator training, trial annotation, and a cross-annotation strategy where discrepancies between two annotators are resolved by a third.
